Package org.example.dao

Class CustomerLogDAO

java.lang.Object
org.example.dao.CustomerLogDAO
public class CustomerLogDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for performing CRUD operations on the customer_logs database table in MariaDB.

Provides persistence and retrieval logic for individual customer metrics recorded during simulation runs, including entry/exit timestamps and total stay durations.

    • saveCustomerLog

      public int saveCustomerLog(CustomerLog log)
      Inserts a new customer log record into the database and assigns the auto-generated primary key ID back to the log object.
      Parameters:
      log - The CustomerLog entity containing individual customer timestamps and metrics.
      Returns:
      The auto-generated log_id primary key if insertion succeeds; -1 if an error occurs.

      public List<CustomerLog> getLogsByRunId(int runId)

      Parameters:
